stem: Daughter:father = 5:6 and father:sister = 6:7. Find daughter:father:sister.

$$\Rightarrow daughter:father=(5\times6):(6\times6)$$

$$\Rightarrow father:sister=(6\times6):(7\times6)$$

$$\Rightarrow 30:36:42$$

$$\Rightarrow 30:36:42=5:6:7$$

Check: both original pairwise ratios are preserved in 5:6:7.

$$\Rightarrow 5:6:7$$

Therefore, daughter:father:sister is

$$\Rightarrow 5 : 6 : 7$$
